dcterms:description: The DSL Corpus Collection (DSLCC) contains sentences in various languages including Bulgarian, Macedonian, Serbian, Croatian, Bosnian, Czech, Slovak, Argentinian Spanish, Peninsular Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, European Portuguese, Malay, and Indonesian, along with a group containing texts written in a set of other languages.

dcterms:description: The HispaBlogs dataset is a collection of Spanish blogs from five different countries: Argentina, Chile, Mexico, Peru, and Spain, used for evaluating language variety identification.
dcterms:title: HispaBlogs Dataset
